name: event-minor-notice
description: Issue #2146: a minor event (the double rainbow, whose only cost is a sliver of the starting cash) arrives as a non-blocking notice card in #bs-event-notices instead of the blocking #bs-event-dialog. The clock keeps running while the card waits, and clicking one of its .bs-notice-choice buttons answers it so no notice is left. The event is raised with the `event fire` test hook; everything after is ticks and real clicks.

steps.description: test hook: `event fire` has no UI control and none is intended. The double rainbow is minor at the starting cash, so it becomes a notice, never the pending event.
The notice card is on screen with its option buttons while the blocking event dialog stays hidden (a hidden overlay has no client width).

expect.note: A minor event shows as a notice card and never as the blocking event dialog.

steps.description: The clock is not held by the notice: ticking is accepted and the tick count advances, and the notice (150 ticks of countdown) is still waiting.
The player answers the notice by clicking its first option; the dialog never opens.

expect.note: Option 0 of the double rainbow is the rainbow break, which costs cash; the notice is gone afterwards.
